items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: he would come over and play Scott Joplin on the organ... I remember distinctly. Scott Joplin.

ctx.x: Yes, when I came on the scene we had an organ, one of those pedal things that you pedal, you know? And I had also an uncle who played piano and he would come over and play Scott Joplin on the organ, you know, -- or ragtime, it wasn't necessarily Scott Joplin, but in later years, say, in 1911 or 12, he was playing Maple Leaf Rag, I remember distinctly. Scott Joplin.
Let me ask you another question. Are there sisters and brothers that you have in your family?
